defaults.description: Alerts that ship turned on: certificate expiry at escalating lead times, failed restore drills, offline nodes and more. Turning one off keeps it off; edits are never overwritten.
defaults.loadError: Could not load the default alerts.
defaults.emptyBody: Default alerts are created on first boot. Any you deleted stay deleted.

title: Alert inbox
description: Alerts that reached you, newest first. Silenced, grouped and rate limited noise is hidden. Read state follows your account.

empty.title: Nothing needs you
empty.body: New firings and resolutions at warning level or above will show up here. Lower the minimum severity below to see more.

prefs.title: Routing and daily digest
prefs.mutedAppsHint: Comma separated app names whose alerts stay out of your inbox.
